exceptions.title: Freight basis conflict: CSV ex-works vs email delivered-included

The email body separately states freight is included up to Bhiwandi DC, as a general claim not tied to these specific line items. Because the two sources conflict and buyer_confirmed_facts does not resolve it, policy lane freight (₹2.1/kg, Vapi→Bhiwandi trailing 6-month average) has been added to reach the delivered basis for these 26 lines, based on the explicit per-line ex-works condition. If the email's freight-included claim actually governs these items, this overstates landed cost by the added freight amount.

Treat email freight-included claim as authoritative and remove added freight
